name: 132.1 — a patch the world cannot hide
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 132.1: patch:occluded(b) reads and writes by arity, the flip keeps the tint, the border, the offset and the ground, a non-boolean is refused, showing a ring through the world costs no draw call and no allocation over showing it the ordinary way, and what a patch costs the ground is the cuts its mask reaches.
